title: AI to End Online Abuse Against Women and Girls
discussion_signal: UN Women frames AI-enabled abuse as a public-sphere participation and accountability problem: inclusive design and stronger governance may reduce harm, while audience reactions connect online abuse to mental health, bias, and the need for affected groups to shape systems. The signal supports platform-exit research while also showing a competing demand for safer redesign and continued participation.
linked_research_question: When online abuse restricts women’s public participation, do users exit, self-censor, organize for accountability, or demand safer platform redesign?
limits: The post does not estimate prevalence across platforms
Comments include claims and interpretations that are not independently verified
